title: Israeli Tourist Trap ‘Herod’s Pool’ Is Draining Palestinians’ Land Dry
summary_full: Israeli lawmakers have promoted visits to an ancient reservoir in the West Bank that was refilled this summer with water diverted from Palestinian-owned farms.
